protocol: Original source unchanged during these trials. Pack-switch Butter warm-up; then Paneer limit3/off, Butter off/limit3. Website caches and sessions retained. App result cache reset per request. All images allowed. No UI dump during loading, except the warm-up overlapped a failed Options attempt and is not a clean comparison. Battery 36.2C. Counts above store count mean all selected stores run together.
limitations: Two queries, one run per configuration, exploratory only.
Butter off was confounded by a Swiggy login gate: CDP confirmed explicit Log in to continue shopping text after no-candidate timeout. Not a valid successful-search speed comparison.
WebView reuse retained but each search still navigates and boots the store app again.
Login fast-failure patch was implemented after this measurement set. These are not before/after timings for that patch.
